changeSet.author: TKlok
changeSet.comment: GOV-18453 Convert Object/ObjectID/ObjectType/ObjectTypeID columns in dbo.Issue table
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Issue_All] AS select t.ID as IssueTypeID ,t.Name as IssueTypeName ,i.[ID] as IssueID ,i.[CreatedOn] ,i.[CreatedBy] ,i.[UpdatedOn] ,i.[UpdatedBy] ,ATT.ObjectID as AssetTypeID ,ATT.Name as AssetTypeName ,ATT.[Object] as [Type] ,a.ID as AssetID ,a.[Uid] ,ATT.[Uid] as AssetTypeUid from Issue i inner Join IssueType t on t.ID = i.IssueTypeID left join AssetType ATT on ATT.ID = i.AssetTypeID left join Asset A on A.ID = i.AssetID
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Issue_All] AS select t.ID as IssueTypeID ,t.Name as IssueTypeName ,i.[ID] as IssueID ,i.[CreatedOn] ,i.[CreatedBy] ,i.[UpdatedOn] ,i.[UpdatedBy] ,ATT.ObjectID as AssetTypeID ,ATT.Name as AssetTypeName ,i.ObjectType as [Type] ,a.ID as AssetID ,a.[Uid] ,ATT.[Uid] as AssetTypeUid from Issue i inner Join IssueType t on t.ID = i.IssueTypeID left join AssetType ATT on ATT.[Object] = i.ObjectType and ATT.ObjectID = i.ObjectTypeID left join Asset A on A.[Object] = i.[Object] and A.[ObjectID] = i.ObjectID
